# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.0 Worker 3 (Slot 95 oe_aip_): 6 Dynamic Historical AI Personalities & Global Eurasian Diplomatic/Expansion Choreography (0 vanilla overrides, 0 ai_diplochance). Generated by gen_v120_epic_ai.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Verified EU5 1.4.9 scripted_diplomatic_objectives schema (complements oe_ai2_* & oe_majors_ai.txt; 0 key overlap).
# Every actor_trigger enforces oe_aip_ai_active = yes (is_ai = yes, is_rebel_country = no, is_subject = no, Rule #18 active).

# 1. Diu Anti-Portuguese Maritime League (1495-1620): MAM / GUJ / ZMR / TUR coordinate against Portuguese Indian Ocean reach
oe_aip_obj_diu_anti_por_league = {
	days_between_checks = 360

	actor_trigger = {
		oe_aip_ai_active = yes
		current_year >= 1495
		current_year <= 1620
		OR = {
			tag = MAM
			tag = GUJ
			tag = ZMR
			tag = TUR
		}
		country_exists = c:POR
		NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = c:POR } }
		c:POR = {
			OR = {
				num_of_ports >= 6
				any_owned_location = {
					OR = {
						sub_continent = sub_continent:south_asia
						region = region:arabia_region
						region = region:persia_region
						region = region:swahili_coast_region
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	recipient_trigger = {
		scope:recipient = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_subject = no
			OR = {
				tag = MAM
				tag = GUJ
				tag = ZMR
				tag = TUR
			}
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			NOT = { is_rival_of = scope:actor }
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
			"opinion(scope:actor)" < 120
		}
	}

	recipient_priority = 55

	pause_trigger = {
		scope:actor = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient }
	}

	cancel_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { country_exists = c:POR }
			current_year > 1620
			scope:actor = { is_rival_of = scope:recipient }
		}
	}

	improve_relation = yes
	improve_relation_limit = 120
	defensive_support = yes
	max_allowed = 2
}

# 2. Portuguese Kochi / Kotte Alliance (1495-1650): POR courts Kochi / Kotte holders against Calicut (ZMR)
oe_aip_obj_por_kochi_kotte_alliance = {
	days_between_checks = 360

	actor_trigger = {
		oe_aip_ai_active = yes
		tag = POR
		current_year >= 1495
		current_year <= 1650
		navy_size >= 12
		OR = {
			location:kochi = { has_owner = yes }
			location:kotte = { has_owner = yes }
		}
	}

	recipient_trigger = {
		scope:recipient = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_subject = no
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			NOT = { tag = ZMR }
			NOT = { is_rival_of = scope:actor }
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
			OR = {
				owns = location:kochi
				owns = location:kotte
			}
			"opinion(scope:actor)" < 120
		}
	}

	recipient_priority = 50

	pause_trigger = {
		scope:actor = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient }
	}

	cancel_trigger = {
		OR = {
			current_year > 1650
			scope:actor = { is_rival_of = scope:recipient }
			scope:recipient = {
				NOT = { owns = location:kochi }
				NOT = { owns = location:kotte }
			}
		}
	}

	improve_relation = yes
	improve_relation_limit = 120
	defensive_support = yes
	max_allowed = 2
}

# 4. Vijayanagar Southern Subcontinent Balance: VIJ stabilizes southern/Malabar friends against BAH / DEC / MUG
oe_aip_obj_vij_deccan_balance = {

		OR = {

			country_exists = c:DEC

		}
	}

	recipient_trigger = {
		scope:recipient = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_subject = no
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			NOT = { tag = BAH }
			NOT = { tag = DEC }
			NOT = { tag = MUG }
			NOT = { is_rival_of = scope:actor }
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
			capital ?= { region = region:deccan_region }
			"opinion(scope:actor)" < 110
		}
	}

	recipient_priority = 45

	pause_trigger = {
		scope:actor = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient }
	}

	cancel_trigger = {
		scope:actor = { is_rival_of = scope:recipient }
	}

	improve_relation = yes
	improve_relation_limit = 110
	defensive_support = yes
	max_allowed = 2
}

				tag = KOR
				tag = MNG
				tag = CHI
			}
			NOT = { is_rival_of = scope:actor }
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }

	recipient_priority = 40

		scope:actor = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient }
	}

	cancel_trigger = {
		OR = {
			current_year >= 1590

		}

# 7. Dutch-English-Portuguese Maritime Rivalry (1600-1780): NED / HOL contest oceanic & spice supremacy
oe_aip_obj_ned_gbr_maritime_rivalry = {
	days_between_checks = 360

		current_year <= 1780
		OR = {
			tag = NED
			tag = HOL
		}
		num_of_ports >= 4
		at_war = no
		oe_ai2_in_fiscal_crisis = no
	}

	recipient_trigger = {
		scope:recipient = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_subject = no
			OR = {
				tag = GBR
				tag = ENG
				tag = POR
			}
			NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:actor } }
		}
	}

	recipient_priority = 42

	pause_trigger = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				oe_ai2_in_fiscal_crisis = yes
				war_exhaustion >= 6
			}
		}
	}

	cancel_trigger = {
		OR = {
			current_year > 1780
			scope:actor = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:recipient } }
		}
	}

	antagonise = yes
	max_allowed = 1
}
